description: Passes one of seven inputs through to the output and draws a new one at random, with every input equally likely, each time a trigger arrives

params.text: Takes its own row's input out of the draw and puts it back; the lamp in the button is lit while that input is in

inputs.text: One of the seven signals the module draws between; its voltage reaches the output for as long as the draw is on it
A trigger draws a new input from those whose buttons are lit; it fires above 2V and rearms below 0.1V

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of whichever input the draw is on, or 0V while every input has been switched out

notes: all seven inputs start in the draw and the first is the one chosen, so the module passes the top input through until a trigger arrives
the lamp beside a jack is lit while the draw is on that input
switching out the input the draw is already on does not move it: the output goes on carrying that input until the next trigger
which input was chosen is written into the patch file but read back wrongly, so a saved patch always reopens on the first input

inputs.7:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
